column1: # Black/Matrix AD - English script: Chapter 1 / Prica

column2: Just because you're awake, you still mustn't move yet!
You've been asleep so long— your body's gonna get all turned around!!
If you're bored, I'll tell you a story, okay?
That day $$おにいちゃん$$ got $$大ケガ$$...
Oh, but you don't remember it, do you!? Sorry...
$$おにいちゃん$$ went up into the mountains to pick $$薬草$$ for me, because I got sick!
Why didn't we go to a $$医者$$?
W-Well...
Um...
I-I don't have... that much money!!
Heehee... (Sorry, $$おにいちゃん$$, 　I can't explain it very well!)
Anyway, $$おにいちゃん$$ went deep into the mountains, and...
It looks like you got caught up in some kind of $$事故$$...
It was...
I think it was a really big $$事故$$...
(Because... 　I really did see it!)
(That day, after the rain stopped...)
(When I could finally move again, I went into the mountains, and...)
(The $$死体$$ of so many $$兵隊さん$$, 　lying all around 　$$おにいちゃん$$...)
When I saw $$おにいちゃん$$, $$血だらけ$$ and nearly dead,
I cried right there for five whole hours...
If $$おにいちゃん$$ died before me, then I...
I'd be so scared and lonely... *sniff*... *sniff*...
If you left me alone, I'd cry so much I'd dieee...
Come on, let's sleep together now! I'm all tired out...
Get better soon, okay!
($$おにいちゃん$$... 　I love you...)
